designVerdict: SELECTED as C3/C4 and C34/C35 - the TPS16630 IN and OUT capacitors, one of each per channel. 220 nF 100 V X7R 0805.
notes: 220 nF against a datasheet MINIMUM of 0.1 uF, and the margin is the point. p.6 Recommended Operating Conditions gives 0.1 uF min at IN, P_IN and OUT. A nominal 100 nF +/-10% part meets that with ZERO margin: tolerance alone puts a bad unit at 90 nF, before X7R's temperature coefficient and before DC-bias loss at 36 V. 220 nF lands around 150-170 nF effective, which clears the minimum in every unit.

This design already applies that reasoning one section away - the TPS54360B's C_IN is specified as >= 3 uF EFFECTIVE after DC-bias derating - and had not carried it to the eFuse's three 0.1 uF minimums.
100 V because C3/C4 sit on the 36 V bus and C34/C35 on the channel outputs.
